name: TC-094 — Verify that clicking "Написати менеджеру" button shows the authentication modal for unauthorized users
description: Verifies that an unauthorized user who navigates to a club details page and clicks the "Написати менеджеру" button sees the authentication modal with the message "Увійдіть або зареєструйтеся!!!".
